lab_rubric: Declarative Writing
All scenarios are purely declarative with zero UI references and clear business intent.
Most scenarios are declarative; minor UI references remain but do not hinder readability.
Some scenarios are rewritten, but many still follow an imperative, click-by-click style.
Scenarios remain imperative or are not rewritten.
Scenario Focus
Every scenario tests exactly one behaviour with a clear, descriptive title.
Most scenarios focus on one behaviour; titles are mostly descriptive.
Several scenarios attempt to test multiple unrelated behaviours at once.
Scenarios are bloated and cover multiple features.
Business Language
Uses domain-specific terminology consistently; scenarios are readable by a Product Owner.
Uses business language; some technical jargon persists.
Scenarios use a mix of business and technical terms that confuse the reader.
Scenarios are written in technical or developer-centric language.
Troubleshooting
Identified the missing setup immediately and fixed it using a Background block.
Identified the missing setup and fixed it by adding a step to the scenario.
Identified that the test failed due to auth but needed help to fix it.
Could not identify why the scenario was failing.
